summary: Delegated roles header truncated by corporate WAF chunking causes RBAC parse failures in private on-prem deployment
description:
Issue summary: Customers report intermittent 403s for admin and batch requests after migrating a large set of delegated roles through an IdP assertion broker. Impact: Customer's scheduled inference batch jobs and a small subset of admin console operations are failing authorization checks (403) despite the identity header being present upstream. This happens only for tenants with very large role lists (hundreds of role bindings) that produce a long 'X-Delegated-Roles' header (base64-encoded JSON). Environment: Private on-prem installation behind Pinebrook's corporate WAF and edge appliance. Private control plane in customer VPC; Redwood's ingress is behind the customer's perimeter WAF. Timeline: Started 2026-03-09 after Pinebrook deployed a synced role export that consolidated service roles into a single assertion header.

Observed behavior: Requests arrive at Redwood but RBAC middleware logs parse errors and returns 403. When the encoded header size exceeds ~8KB, the customer's WAF splits/strips header fragments instead of forwarding intact, which results in truncated JSON after base64 decode and an authz parse failure.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure IdP trust broker to emit aggregated roles into a single 'X-Delegated-Roles' header as base64(JSON) with ~250 role entries.
2) Send an authenticated admin API request or a batch inference request through customer's WAF to private Redwood ingress.
3) Observe 403 response from Redwood authz middleware for some requests; other requests succeed when header size is below the threshold.
4) Capture request on customer edge and on Redwood ingress to compare header payloads (pre- and post-WAF).
logs: 2026-03-09T14:03:21Z authz: error parsing delegated roles header 'X-Delegated-Roles': unexpected end of JSON at byte 8190
2026-03-09T14:03:21Z http: request from 10.12.54.21 method=POST path=/v1/infer status=403 duration_ms=21 user=svc-batch-pb tenant=pinebrook
investigation_notes: Initial triage by Support found consistent correlation between header size and failures. Packet captures from customer show the WAF rewriting large headers into multiple header lines without proper reassembly. Base64 decode on the reassembled header fails because fragments are being dropped or clipped at 8KB boundaries. Reproduced locally by injecting an 8.5KB header through a reverse-proxy configured to chunk headers — reproduced authz parse error 'unexpected end of JSON'. Hypothesis: customer's WAF enforces an 8KB per-header limit and uses header chunking that our ingress does not reassemble. Alternative cause considered: our ingress trimming or internal buffer, but local tests with intact headers show success. We engaged SRE for ingress config review; no recent changes on Redwood ingress that would truncate headers. Customer has Palo Alto PA-7000 with default header-size limits and an HAProxy-based edge doing header folding.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:12 - Support (Ravi Patel): Customer reported ~15% of scheduled batch jobs failing with 403 since 03/09 morning. They attached example request ids and packet captures. Added to triage.

2026-03-10 11:47 - SRE (Diego Alvarez): Confirmed parse error string in our logs for the supplied request IDs. Reproduced local failure with artificially chunked header. No ingress-side recent deploys that would explain change.
2026-03-10 15:30 - Customer (Lara Kim, Pinebrook): We upgraded IdP exporter to include consolidated service roles yesterday. We can temporarily disable consolidation if that helps.

2026-03-11 08:05 - Support (Ava Thompson): Suggested two immediate workarounds: 1) reduce header size by splitting roles across two headers (X-Delegated-Roles-1/2) or 2) switch to token introspection endpoint so roles are fetched server-side. Pinebrook prefers an ingress/WAF fix.

2026-03-11 14:22 - Customer (Lara Kim): Palo Alto support confirmed header-size enforcement and recommended increasing 'application-header-max-size' on their appliance. They will schedule a config change during a maintenance window.

2026-03-12 09:55 - SRE (Diego Alvarez): Implemented a defensive server-side reassembly attempt for chunked headers (edge-case handling) in staging to tolerate common WAF chunking patterns. Still planning additional tests before prod rollout.
2026-03-12 13:01 - Support (Ava Thompson): Updated ticket with temporary mitigation guidance and tracked related internal follow-up INT-45290 for ingress enhancement.
resolution: Workaround applied and change planned: Pinebrook will increase their WAF/application header size limit to allow unchunked 'X-Delegated-Roles' headers (maintenance window completed 2026-03-12 22:00 UTC). Support worked with SRE to deploy a defensive reassembly patch to intake service in staging to handle simple chunked headers; patch will be promoted to prod after validation (planned 2026-03-15). Final fix options: 1) recommend customers avoid extremely large single headers and instead use token introspection or split role assertions across multiple well-known headers; 2) ingress-level reassembly and improved parsing tolerant to header chunking patterns — tracked as INT-45290. Postmortem action items: update private-deploy runbook to include WAF header-size guidance, add a validation check during onboarding that flags very large delegation assertions, and add Confluence doc with recommended patterns. Ticket will be closed after prod patch deploy and customer confirms successful job runs.
